argument: Chapter 10 is not publishable as written: it is the magic framework, yet it hands readers no pointers and it makes two claims that contradict shipped canon. Broken: [10-magic-system:65] states that no Discipline substitution exists for any card, but the Odd's shipped Eccentric Spellcasting lets two chosen abilities skip Discipline prerequisites (level gates still bind), per [05-classes.qmd:287], [02-character-creation.qmd:301] and [21-glossary.qmd:81]; the convention forbids any blanket no-wildcard claim, so the minimal fix is to scope that sentence to class-signature exceptions and cite the Odd. Broken: [10-magic-system:29] promises there is no concentration roll, while [10-magic-system:115] orders a Fortitude check to keep an ongoing spell up; the expected state is one consistent rule, meaning line 29 should say no roll decides whether the spell fires and Limitations should own the single check. Incomplete: the raise/trade cost is absent, so a reader who bought a card at Novice (2 DP) cannot tell whether lifting it to Master costs the full 8 DP or only the 6 DP difference plus the newly required Discipline ranks; because card price is keyed flat to tier (ch08's cost table) and [10-magic-system:55] only says the new effect row applies, the chapter must state the upgrade delta and that new rank costs come with it. Incomplete: the concentration rule at [10-magic-system:115] gives no target number, no success tier and no rule for a second hit; add 'Standard or better on 3d6 + Fortitude' and repeat the check on each damaging hit. Incomplete: the chapter carries zero cross-reference tokens, and [10-magic-system:89] sends readers to 'its spell chapter' without naming ch11 or ch12, so nothing routes them from framework to actual cards; add @sec-chapter-arcane-spells and @sec-chapter-divine-spells, plus @sec-chapter-disciplines or @sec-damage-budget at the tier table. Routed out: cantrip DP cost is never stated here while [08-disciplines.qmd:214] charges 2 DP for prereq-free basics and [11-arcane-spells.qmd:27] says cantrips are free. Also tidy: precedence between the per-encounter limit (Adept and Master) and the per-session limit (Master) is unstated, 'rank' is used for both card tier and Discipline rank, and the worked example prints a 15-point center bonus on an Adept card at [10-magic-system:133] that the ch11 card does not carry. Verified clean: heading structure and section order are workable; exactly one typst fence with its label after the H1; both tables carry outlined: false; the callout uses the named body: form; zero em-dashes and zero bare @; the label resolves and is cited from ch01, ch09, ch11 and ch12; both tables reprint ch08's flat costs and damage rows exactly; and the worked casting roll recomputes to the tier it claims. Tiered disposition: T1 fix the two contradictions first; T2 state the upgrade cost, finish the concentration procedure and add the cross-references; T3 clarify limitation precedence and rank-versus-tier wording and correct the example's off-row number.
